functions.name: initialize
functions.doc: Initialize token metadata and the admin allowed to mint

inputs.name: decimal
inputs.doc: Number of decimals used to represent amounts

functions.name: admin
functions.doc: Return the admin address allowed to mint

functions.name: mint
functions.doc: Mint new tokens to an address. Requires the admin's authorization

functions.name: decimals
functions.doc: Return the number of decimals used to represent amounts

functions.name: total_supply
functions.doc: Return the total number of tokens in existence

functions.name: balance
functions.doc: Return the token balance held by an address

functions.name: allowance
functions.doc: Return the amount a spender may still transfer on behalf of an owner. Expired allowances report 0

functions.name: approve
functions.doc: Approve a spender to transfer up to an amount until an expiration ledger. Requires the owner's authorization

inputs.name: amount
inputs.doc: Maximum amount the spender may transfer

inputs.name: expiration_ledger
inputs.doc: Ledger at which the allowance expires

functions.name: transfer
functions.doc: Transfer tokens from one address to another. Requires the sender's authorization

functions.name: transfer_from
functions.doc: Transfer tokens using an allowance. Requires the spender's authorization

functions.name: burn
functions.doc: Burn tokens from an address. Requires the owner's authorization

functions.name: burn_from
functions.doc: Burn tokens using an allowance. Requires the spender's authorization

errorCodes.name: AlreadyInitialized
errorCodes.doc: The contract has already been initialized

errorCodes.name: NotInitialized
errorCodes.doc: The contract has not been initialized yet

errorCodes.name: NegativeAmount
errorCodes.doc: Amounts must be zero or positive

errorCodes.name: InsufficientBalance
errorCodes.doc: The address does not hold enough tokens

errorCodes.name: InsufficientAllowance
errorCodes.doc: The allowance is too small for this transfer
